## History

Magog was one of the cats present at Patty's Place during [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends' living arrangement there. During an unexpected Friday visit by [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) Gardner's mother and sisters, the household was caught off guard, resulting in an awkward encounter that featured rambunctious behavior from the cats.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P30](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0030), [v3 ch.Place P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 ch.Place P59](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0059), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), +2 more_
